description: COMMENT ON for the extended object types: SEQUENCE (comment sits in DESC SEQUENCE's own comment column of its one columnar row), FILE FORMAT (comment surfaces in SHOW FILE FORMATS only - DESCRIBE lists format properties with no COMMENT row, live-verified), and MASKING / ROW ACCESS POLICY (accepted without error). Converted 1:1 from ddl/CommentOnExtTest (now retired).

steps.sql: COMMENT ON SEQUENCE s1 IS 'my seq'
CREATE FILE FORMAT ff TYPE = CSV
COMMENT ON FILE FORMAT ff IS 'fmt note'
CREATE MASKING POLICY mp AS (v STRING) RETURNS STRING -> '***'
CREATE ROW ACCESS POLICY rap AS (v STRING) RETURNS BOOLEAN -> TRUE
COMMENT ON MASKING POLICY mp IS 'mask note'
COMMENT ON ROW ACCESS POLICY rap IS 'rap note'
